easyPrerequisites: You control a creature with power 5 or greater, or you have a creature card in your graveyard with power 5 or greater.
description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Ambitious Dragonborn. Ambitious Dragonborn enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
Activate Ambitious Dragonborn using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
